jobs.occupation: Longevity Beverage & Botanical Mixology (Bar / Lounge) (Barmixer/in, Barkeeper/in)
jobs.description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
Experienced bartender

Stellenbeschreibung:
Job Title: Alchemist of Botanical Spirits – Head Mixologist / Longevity Bar Trainee (m/f/d)

Focus: 100% Non-Alcoholic Pairing, Fermentation & Cellular Elixirs

Location: Allgäu, Germany (Bavaria)

Contract: Full-Time / Trainee Program

Anyone can pour gin and tonic. Can you build an alcohol-free dopamine pairing?

We are leaving industrial spirits behind. Our lounge and restaurant operate on a radical premise: 100% Alcohol-Free, 100% Functional.

We craft custom botanical extractions, cold-brewed medicinal teas, live ferments, and adaptogenic distillates that elevate dining without neurotoxins or glucose crashes.

Your Playground & Impact:

· Formulate cutting-edge mocktails, water kefirs, house kombuchas, and herbal hydrosols using commercial vacuum blenders and slow juicers.

· Design functional liquid pairings tailored to our 10 guest archetypes (focus, deep sleep, metabolic calm).

· Complete our Master/Bachelor Traineeship in Functional Beverages & Phytotherapy with university credentials.

Who You Are:

· Experienced bartender or beverage professional fascinated by fermentation, botanicals, and liquid craftsmanship.

· Great floor presence, confident in explaining the biochemical narrative of each glass to international guests.

· Opportunity Card holders, international mixologists, or hospitality talents currently in the EU/Germany with strong English skills.

What We Offer (Candidate Value Proposition):

· Academic University Certification: Official trainee certificate / module in Longevity Nutrition & Functional Food from an accredited German university partner.

· Visa & Relocation Support: Full guidance through official immigration procedures, Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte), or German work permits, plus initial on-site resort accommodation.

· Green Michelin Star Mission: Active, pioneering role in building Germany’s benchmark for Sustainable & Functional Fine Dining from day one.

· Cutting-Edge Food Lab: Access to professional vacuum blending, cold-press extraction technology, fermentation chambers, and an extensive in-house botanical garden.

How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail: longevity@allgaeuresort.info

jobs.description:

Das Familienunternehmen mit Stammsitz in Weißenhorn bedient mit rund 10.000 Mitarbeitern und deutlich mehr als 140 Lagerstandorten in über 63 Ländern seine Kunden mit innovativen Systemgeräten und umfangreichen Serviceleistungen rund um die Schalungs- und Gerüsttechnik.

Turning complex supply chains into smart, digital flows.
We're searching for an experienced SAP S/4HANA Expert with a strong focus on Production Planning (PP)- someone who brings deep industry understanding, process excellence, and the technical chops to drive digital transformation from concept to go-live.

- Take the lead in designing and implementing processes for our production plants
- Provide hands-on customizing and process consulting in the line-of-business "Manufacturing"
- Ensure seamless integration across modules like purchasing, warehouse management, sales, and maintenance
- Support the implementation and adaptation of Fiori apps and mobile solutions in production and logistics environments
- Act as a key advisor for production teams and business stakeholders throughout the ERP transformation journey
- Align production and logistics flows with IT architecture and corporate standards
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enable lean, agile production environments
- Train and support useres

What you bring - your expert profile:

- Degree in Business Informatics, Computer Science or a comparable qualification
- Proven experience as SAP S/4HANA consultant or in-house expert in PP and other logistics modules
- Deep understanding of SAP customizing, process integration and interface topics
- Confident in working with Fiori, mobile use cases, and modern UX strategies
- Strong know-how in production planning, supply chain flows, and manufacturing processes - ideally within capital goods, construction materials, or wood/metal industries
- Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills
- Team player with a coaching attitude - you support others and lead by example
- Good knowledge of German and English

Why join us:

- Remuneration and additional benefits that convince: With us, you can look forward to a pay scale including holiday pay and Christmas bonus. In addition, you can expect a company-sponsored pension scheme, capital-forming benefits and an employee referral program including a bonus.
- Safe and healthy: With a secure job in a fast-growing and traditional family-owned company, you can look to the future without worries. You can also benefit from our health promotion (e.g.height-adjustable desks) and company fitness via EGYM with more than 4,500 network partners, bicycle leasing or PERI company sports groups.
- Grow beyond yourself: Annual employee appraisals, further training advice and support, exchange and mentoring programmes as well as leadership training support you in your professional development. In our PERI Academy, you can take advantage of a wide range of training opportunities as well as free access to online learning platforms such as LinkedIn Learning and getAbstract.

Our Search Team within CHECK24 AI Forge develops scalable AI solutions for search and ranking across different CHECK24 products. Search and Ranking are among the most demanding disciplines in applied machine learning. A successful system needs to understand user intent, retrieve relevant candidates, rank them effectively and meet demanding requirements for latency, scalability and measurable customer impact.
To strengthen our team, we are looking for someone with first relevant hands-on experience who is eager to grow into a strong Applied Machine Learning Engineer. In this role, you will work on production systems combining classical information retrieval, deep learning, embeddings and Large Language Models and contribute across the entire lifecycle from initial idea and evaluation to deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement.
We look forward to receiving your application as a (Junior) Data Scientist (m/f/d) Search at CHECK24 AI Forge GmbH.

Was Du mitbringst:

- You have successfully completed a degree (typically a Master's) in computer science, mathematics, statistics, physics, electrical engineering or a comparable quantitative field, with strong grades in quantitative subjects
- At least one year of relevant hands-on experience in machine learning or data science is part of your background, including relevant experience gained through working-student positions, internships or your own projects
- Strong Python skills and practical experience with machine-learning or deep-learning frameworks such as PyTorch are part of your technical toolkit
- Solid classical machine-learning skills like gradient boosting, regression and feature engineering are evident in your CV, beyond LLM or RAG applications
- You have practical experience with applications based on Large Language Models, LLM evaluation, tool use or agentic workflows
- A solid understanding of machine-learning fundamentals and systematic model evaluation enables you to assess and improve model performance
- Practical experience with APIs (e.g. FastAPI), containers and Git, ideally a deployed service, complements your interest in building complete production services
- Knowledge of information retrieval, semantic search, recommender systems or learning-to-rank approaches is a plus
- You have English proficiency at C1 level or higher; German is a plus but not required

Zu Deinen Aufgaben zählen:

- You develop and improve machine-learning services for retrieval, ranking, query understanding and classification
- Hybrid search solutions combine lexical retrieval, embeddings, neural models and components based on Large Language Models
- Model development covers training, fine-tuning and systematic evaluation for semantic search, relevance prediction and learning-to-rank use cases
- You create reliable evaluation datasets and metrics and validate improvements through offline evaluations, user signals and A/B tests
- Production-ready services are built from prototypes using technologies such as Python, FastAPI, Docker, PyTorch and vector databases
- Modern AI-assisted and agentic engineering workflows enable efficient prototyping, testing and continuous improvement
- You research promising approaches in information retrieval, recommender systems and Large Language Models and translate them into measurable customer impact

Was wir Dir bieten:
Development and responsibility

- Your commitment pays off – we support your talent and provide opportunities to grow your career quickly
- Take ownership of your topics, contribute your own ideas, try new approaches and gradually assume responsibility for production Search and Ranking systems
- Benefit from internal training with specialized coaches as well as an annual budget for external professional development
Team spirit and modern workspace

Flexibility and balance
